proposed_synthetic_operator_trial.status: not executed; blocked on reviewed product adapter and activation approval
proposed_synthetic_operator_trial.scope: unique authorized workspace paths and deterministic bounded data; zero model calls
steps: Admit one v2 goal with two sealed permitted workspace operations and one final output destination
Step 1 saves a small draft and verifies its exact content/hash; persist its artifact
Terminate only the designated goal worker process after the step-1 checkpoint; do not restart shared databases or gateways
Resume the worker; step 2 writes a final artifact using the exact persisted first artifact; deliver it once to the designated result path
Read goal state and actual workspace files; compare hashes, per-operation dispatch/observation receipts and final delivery count
Repeat in a new goal with cancel after step 1; verify first file persists and no second/final artifact or new dispatch occurs
proposed_synthetic_operator_trial.required_result: Two dependent effects and one verified final delivery, or stopped goal with preserved first artifact; cost unknown where unreported
proposed_synthetic_operator_trial.limitations: This does not prove general multi-day projects, ordinary conversation initiation or arbitrary provider exactly-once effects
